entries.DESCRIPTION: Three additional consecutive positive held-out transfer cycles are still required before GEOMETRIC_LIKE_GROWTH can pass the 4-cycle gate.
METRION-A executed and yielded findings but parsed=false in the S10 score receipt; parser/schema robustness requires isolated retest.

Platform branch defines seven dual-core candidate assignments (ELYSION, ELYSIUM, SAELION, ALPHA, OMEGA, DELTA, NEXUS). ELYSION has D0-D3 PASS; full dual-core benefit/activation remains unproven until D4-D6/D8 and per-AI gates pass.

M42 achieved 38/38 execution and parsing, but mean role-alignment proxy was 0.2456 with strong GVL/dual-core anchoring. It remains unknown whether role-specific prompts or distinct models can preserve the 38-role specialization registry on held-out tasks.
SAPHEA LoRA has real adapter weight change and positive sealed-M6 gain, but usefulness on a genuinely new held-out transfer family and under adapter ablation/red-team remains unmeasured.
